text: Like all convalescents, he was tremendously hungry, and the reporter allowed him to eat as much as he liked, for he trusted to that instinct, which is too often wanting in reasoning beings, to keep the orang from any excess. Neb was delighted to see his pupil’s appetite returning. “Eat away, my Jup,” said he, “and don’t spare anything; you have shed your blood for us, and it is the least I can do to make you strong again!” On the 25th of August Neb’s voice was heard calling to his companions. “Captain, Mr. Spilett, Mr. Herbert, Pencroft, come! come!” The colonists, who were together in the dining-room, rose at Neb’s call, who was then in Jup’s room.
